name: simplechart-human-design
description: Human Design charts, cycles, transits, synthesis & chart comparison — ask in plain language.
long_description:
Adds Human Design to your AI. Once installed, just ask in plain language — for example: "Calculate the Human Design chart for 9 April 1948, 00:05, Montreal" — and the assistant returns the full bodygraph: type, authority, profile, centers, channels and every planet. Also does planetary cycles, live transits, a plain-language synthesis, and connection analysis between two people. Powered by simplechartcalculator.com.

SETUP: after installing, paste your API key in the field below. Don't have one? Get a free key at simplechartcalculator.com/register (takes 30 seconds). Keep the key private — it counts against your plan.
